div.div: حِصَّةٌ A portion of a sum: (Er-Rághib:) and used to signify a portion, lot, or share, (S, Msb, Er-Rághib, K,) of food, and of beverage, and of land, &c.: (TA:) accord. to some, from حَصَّهُ signifying “ he cut off from it: ” (TA:) pl. حِصَصٌ. (A, Msb, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
